name: ODU Big Blue Spring 2019
information:
Please note that this will be in a different room than previous ODU competitions.

All net proceeds will go to Engineers Without Borders, a group of engineers who benefit underserved communities.

Tentative Rounds: A second round of 4x4 and 3x3 One-Handed will be held ONLY if there is extra time before 3x3 Final. If there is still extra time, 3x3 Final will be in a Head to Head format.
